fuente.titulo: Pope Leo XIV: 'If technology is not applied ethically, risks for humanity are enormous'

titular: Pope warns of risks from ungoverned technology
bajada: Address to Space Forum 2026 stresses ethical limits on emerging tech
caption: Speaking to the International Space Forum 2026, Pope Leo XIV thanked participants for promoting the common good, but warned that without ethical governance, 'the risks for humanity are enormous.' Source: Vatican News, Nov 21, 2026.

ilustracion.descripcion: A softly lit conference hall with a large screen showing abstract digital and space imagery; a robed papal figure stands at a podium in the upper right third, left and center space open and uncluttered.
